subject.title: [Feature request] UX : Simplify multi-provider LLM management in the OpenClaw dashboard

question: Should this issue cover only a guided provider/model manager, or should OpenClaw core also define automatic task- and cost-based model-routing policy?
rationale: The provider manager aligns with current Control UI and plugin contracts, while automatic semantic routing changes runtime policy, cost, capability, and data-destination behavior and has previously been declined in broader forms.

options.title: Phase provider management first
options.body: Build the guided provider, credential, catalog, default, and fallback workflow now, and track automatic routing separately after its policy contract is approved.

options.title: Approve the combined roadmap
options.body: Treat provider management and automatic routing as one larger product program with explicit routing semantics, security review, and phased delivery.

options.title: Keep routing external
options.body: Add the provider-management UI to core but require automatic routing to use provider gateways or plugin-owned hooks outside core.

recommendation.title: Phase provider management first
recommendation.body: Build the guided provider, credential, catalog, default, and fallback workflow now, and track automatic routing separately after its policy contract is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent provider-neutral usage contracts and Control UI provider-card work make this the strongest available product and implementation ownership signal.
